visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A high-definition close-up shot of a strawberry parfait served in a stemmed wine glass. A professional-grade kitchen torch held by an off-screen hand emits a blue flame, caramelizing the thick custard topping into a dark brown crust while wisps of white smoke rise. The strawberries inside appear juicy and bright red against the creamy white layers. (2) A wide-angle interior shot of the cafe with a soft, blurred focus. The floor features a high-contrast black and white checkerboard pattern, extending towards the back where several customers are seated at light-colored tables. The ceiling is decorated with warm chandeliers and lush green trailing plants, creating a garden-like indoor atmosphere. (3) A medium close-up of a hand holding a decorative cookie shaped like a bear wearing a hooded raccoon outfit. The video cuts to a brightly lit table covered with a diverse array of strawberry-themed desserts, including two parfaits, a pudding, a bun, and a large dessert pizza, all garnished with fresh fruit and edible flowers. (4) A detailed process shot showing metal tongs carefully placing large, whole strawberries into a glass. An off-screen person pipes thick white custard in a decorative wave pattern onto a biscuit base. The camera then captures the close-up torched finish, showing the sugar bubbling and turning into a crispy, caramelized glaze on top of the cream. (5) A montage of close-up shots highlighting different dessert textures. A strawberry bun is sliced open to reveal a rich, pale yellow cream filling. A rosette of whipped cream is squeezed onto a golden caramel pudding topped with strawberries. Thick, deep red strawberry jam is poured from a tiny glass pitcher onto a slice of cheesecake. (6) A top-down view of a strawberry dessert pizza featuring a golden crust topped with custard rosettes, fresh strawberry halves, and melted cheese. A slice is pulled away to show the gooey cheese and crispy edges. Two glass bottles of pink strawberry smoothies with red ribbons and bear stickers are presented on a rustic wood surface. (7) A clear exterior shot of DAISY VILLA during a bright, sunny day. The storefront is painted white with large arched windows and a prominent gold sign above the entrance. Lush green trees and potted flowering plants surround the outdoor seating area, which includes dark metal chairs and wooden tables under the natural sunlight.
